checks.details: Correct fixture passed, injected fault failed simulation, repaired fixture passed.
Icarus 12 compile and simulation passed without diagnostics; 4138 positive-edge oracle comparisons.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
Original problem does not specify power-up state; testbench begins checking after a sampled reset.
No synthesis or board verification was performed, as required.
implementation: Five-state FSM recognizes contiguous 1101 with suffix retention and an absorbing FOUND state. Active-high synchronous reset returns to SEARCH. Output asserts immediately after the edge sampling the final sequence bit.
verification: Independent rolling four-bit history oracle, exhaustive eight-bit input streams, directed long-one suffix case, sticky persistence, partial-match reset, reset priority, repeated reset, and inter-edge reset pulse. Bounded timeout and fatal mismatch checks.
static_review: Original one-bit ports and TopModule name preserved; explicit enum if/else transitions, complete combinational assignments, one sequential driver, no extra latency or ports.
